title: Monitoring Ceiling: Wellness-Plan Urinalysis and Blood Panels for Tailwise Pharmacy Diet Orders
content:
*Clinical monitoring note, pharmacy and clinics.*

The days' supply per fill of a new Tailwise Pharmacy prescription diet order placed for a pet whose diet another household pet already takes is no more than the monitoring ceiling. The monitoring ceiling reads the urinalysis and blood panel services redeemed under the customer's Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans, as the plans' service ledger records them.

| Urinalysis or blood panel redeemed | Monitoring ceiling |
|---|---|
| at least one within the 3 calendar months ending on the order date | the class's maximum days' supply per fill |
| none within those 3 months, but at least one within the 12 calendar months ending on the order date | 45 days: the 30-day new-order days' supply plus 15 days |
| none within the 12 months | 30 days |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; order dated 2026-09-10)

- Blood panel redeemed on 2026-07-02: within 3 months, class maximum.
- Urinalysis redeemed on 2026-02-15 only: within 12 months but not 3, 45 days.
- Wellness exam and core vaccine redeemed in the period, no urinalysis or blood panel: 30 days.

Only urinalysis and blood panel services count; other redeemed services do not.
